description: This file defines a base interface 'Node' for predicate nodes in an abstract syntax tree (AST) within the RQL predicate package. It provides the accept method for the visitor pattern, enabling traversal and operations on AST nodes.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Interface for all predicate nodes in an AST, facilitating the visitor pattern.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor, which executes the appropriate visit method for this node.
